name: test_verify_orders_page_loads_after_login[chromium]
description:
Test Case 1: Verify Orders Page Loads Successfully After Login

Steps:
    1. Navigate to Amazon homepage
    2. Click on "Account & Lists" to login
    3. Enter credentials and login
    4. Navigate to "Returns & Orders" / Your Orders page
    5. Verify the orders page is loaded (check for filter dropdown or page title)
    6. Verify page title contains "Your Orders"

Expected Result:
    - User should be redirected to orders page
    - Page title should display "Your Orders"
    - Orders filter dropdown should be visible
